what: Taking the per-clip best AUC across arms makes three of the four Tier 1 boards worse.

entry_if_auc_maximised.packed: kit packer pass, kit validator pass, 0 findings, submittable -- and not submitted

why: Each tier is scored on four boards. e06's clean-input rollout gains 0.093 AUC and loses its MP-SR pass; e21's gains 0.005 AUC and loses its SP-SR pass while MPPE goes 4.78 -> 66.20 cm; e28's gains 0.003 AUC and worsens MPPE by 19 cm. AUC rewards the whole error curve, the success rates are hard gates, and a rollout can trade one for the other.
decision: Keep the shipped entry. Across the arms we hold it is already Pareto-optimal.
adoption_rule_registered_for_the_fine_tu: A clip's new rollout is adopted only if its kit AUC improves AND spider_sr does not fall AND maniptrans_sr does not fall AND mppe_cm does not rise. Legal on Tier 1 because the tier's own input_note names the released trajectory as the configured scoring reference, so these are measurements against the permitted input. On Tier 2 the input-only z-drop rule stays.
